method: R5 normalized token sets; binary-tf BM25 over title+description union, k1=1.2, b=.75; score divided by sum(query IDF)*(k1+1); cap=3; no specific-match gate; stable source-order ties

results.message: Let patients recover forgotten passwords with an SMS one-time code too.
Change the appointment cancellation cutoff from 24 hours to 2 hours.
Drop card payments for invoices in the first release.
Send booking updates through WhatsApp as well as email.
Replace the monthly CSV with an interactive clinic analytics dashboard.
Move the prescription download link into the medical visit timeline.
Use magic links rather than passwords when a patient signs in.
When an appointment is booked, email the patient and let them add it to their calendar.
A locked-out patient should receive a fresh recovery link.
Accept debit cards when a patient settles an outstanding balance.
Remind patients by text message on the morning of their visit.
Let a patient print medication instructions from the visit record.
Confirm a newly reserved consultation by email.
Include paid invoice totals in the monthly clinic export.
After reserving a visit, email the patient and make the prescription and bill downloadable.
Use patient credentials for sign-in but send a recovery code when they are forgotten.
Let clinicians conduct video consultations.
Offer a dark visual theme for the patient portal.
Change the booking window so visits can be reserved six months ahead.
Only clinic managers may download the monthly spreadsheet.
Allow buyers to stack two discount coupons on one checkout.
Do not hide unavailable items; show them with a back-order date.
Add PayPal alongside card and bank transfer at payment.
Let anyone leave a star rating before their purchase is delivered.
Text the buyer when the parcel leaves the warehouse and include its tracking link.
Remove anonymous purchasing so every buyer must register.
Search should understand SKU identifiers in addition to product names.
A support agent needs to return money as store credit instead of to the original tender.
Permit checkout without opening a profile.
Find red shoes by SKU, then narrow the results to in-stock products under fifty dollars.
Keep basket contents when a shopper changes item quantities.
Return a card payment in full when support approves the return.
Display sold-out catalog items and their expected restock date.
A verified buyer may edit their product rating after delivery.
Apply a voucher only when its promotion is still valid.
Email the tracking number as soon as an order ships.
Registered shoppers should authenticate with a password before viewing their account.
A signed-in buyer should add items to a basket and pay for the order.
Allow shoppers to save a wishlist for later.
Give warehouse workers a packing productivity dashboard.
Increase the maximum document attached to a task from 25 MB to 100 MB.
Post assignment and deadline alerts into Slack, not only email.
Allow security history to be searched for a full year rather than ninety days.
Add GraphQL access to projects and tasks alongside the existing REST interface.
When a task changes, send a signed callback to a customer URL.
Show workload grouped by department on the cross-project overview.
Support searching inside uploaded documents as well as task text.
Purge a closed workspace immediately instead of retaining deleted data for thirty days.
Company members must use the corporate identity provider instead of local credentials.
Invite a colleague as a read-only member.
Bring a closed project back into the active workspace.
Let members reply to one another in a discussion attached to a task.
Bundle assignment alerts and due-date reminders into one daily message.
Put PDF status exports next to portfolio health charts.
Let the owner download an invoice before paying the plan renewal.
Erase a terminated tenant and its projects without waiting thirty days.
Administrators need twelve months of searchable security events.
Create a task, discuss it, and attach the supporting brief.
Track billable time spent on each task.
Start a video call with everyone in the workspace.
